name: Grilled river fish
summary: River and stream fish grilled on charcoal with no marinade, then dipped in chili salt, lá é salt, or yellow ant salt. The Vietnam National Authority of Tourism, 22 July 2022, is the account.
origin: The 22 July 2022 river-food article sets grilled fish beside the named Gia Lai plates, and says the fish comes from rivers, streams, and fields rather than a pond.
howToEat: Clamp the fish on sharpened bamboo and grill it over charcoal. The same article also wraps it in banana leaf or buries it in ash.
No marinade before the fire. Dip it in chili salt, lá é salt, or yellow ant salt.
where: Rivers and streams in Gia Lai. A street is Check on arrival. An hour is Check on arrival.
The same article names cá lăng, anh vũ, and a fish called sọc dưa as further Sê San species cooked into dishes it does not name.
